purpose: LOCAL/MOCKED ONLY. Build and qualify a durable, resumable B2Z execution boundary that fixes the two real gaps found in B2Z-P0 (no resume, no pre-dispatch durability), without touching the already-qualified B2ZRunner. No provider/RPC calls made. No live execution performed.

part1_current_implementation_trace.confirmed_exact_flow: B2ZRunner.__init__ (validates manifest, binds projection, requires exact 20-member match) -> run() (require_empty() ledger check, zero transport counter check) -> per member sequentially: stage1 getTransaction -> resolve_creator() -> stage2 getSignaturesForAddress -> filter candidates -> stage3 getTransaction -> validate funding_time/proves_inbound_sol_funding -> append result -> next member -> final counter cross-check
exception_points_identified: _result(): RPC error field, missing result, transaction meta.err != null
candidate filtering: B2Z_FIRST_NON_SUCCESS_STOP_NO_CANDIDATE if empty after filter
part1_current_implementation_trace.confirmed_gap_1_no_resume: PhysicalAttemptLedger.require_empty() is called at the START of run() -- proven by tests/test_oip_v2_2e_2b2bp_execution_boundary.py::test_existing_ledger_and_nonzero_client_counter_fail_before_request that a non-empty ledger makes construction/run refuse entirely (B2Z_LEDGER_MUST_BE_EMPTY)
part1_current_implementation_trace.confirmed_gap_2_no_pre_dispatch_durabili: B2ZRunner._call() only calls self.ledger.append() AFTER the try/except block completes (success or caught exception) -- there is no durable write BEFORE self.transport.post_json() is invoked, unlike B2N's PreDispatchEventLedger.append_event(event='ATTEMPT_RESERVED', ...) which executes before the network call
part1_current_implementation_trace.action_taken: did NOT modify src/acquisition/b2z_execution_boundary.py or B2ZRunner -- its 11 tests remain byte-identical and passing (re-run this milestone, zero regressions). Built a PARALLEL module, src/acquisition/b2z_durable_execution.py, that reuses the identical evidence-rule functions (resolve_creator, proves_inbound_sol_funding imported directly from b2z_execution_boundary.py, not reimplemented) behind a new durability layer.

part2_stage_identities.identity_binding: StageIdentity dataclass binds (run_id, sample_ordinal, mint, stage); every event ledger entry additionally carries physical_request_number, provider, endpoint_family, method, dependency_digest, request_digest -- a completed stage for one member can never be confused with the same stage for another member (keyed by (sample_ordinal, stage) tuples throughout) or a different stage for the same member

part3_pre_dispatch_event_ledger.implementation: B2ZEventLedger.append_event(event='ATTEMPT_RESERVED', ...) called by DurableB2ZClient.dispatch() BEFORE self._transport.post_json(...) is invoked -- proven by test_reservation_written_before_dispatch_for_every_stage (asserts events[0]['event']=='ATTEMPT_RESERVED' precedes events[1])
part3_pre_dispatch_event_ledger.no_credential_bearing_field: confirmed -- request_digest is a SHA-256 hash of {method, params}, never the raw endpoint URL or any credential; the module never imports os.environ or constructs a transport (confirmed by test_no_credential_symbols_anywhere_in_module)

part4_terminal_events.append_only_confirmed: B2ZEventLedger has no update/delete method -- append_event() only ever appends a new line
part4_terminal_events.distinguishing_logic: DurableB2ZClient.dispatch() compares transport.physical_request_count before/after the try block: if an exception occurs and the counter changed, ATTEMPT_FAILED_AFTER_DISPATCH is recorded (budget consumed); if the counter did NOT change (exception raised before or during construction, never reaching the transport), ATTEMPT_NOT_DISPATCHED is recorded (budget NOT consumed) -- mirrors B2N's DurableAccountingClient.acquire_once() dispatched-detection pattern exactly

part5_physical_request_accounting.canonical_definition: B2ZEventLedger.physical_requests_attempted() counts only (sample_ordinal, stage) pairs whose terminal event is ATTEMPT_SUCCEEDED or ATTEMPT_FAILED_AFTER_DISPATCH -- ATTEMPT_NOT_DISPATCHED pairs are excluded
part5_physical_request_accounting.proven_max_3_per_member: test_full_member_completes_in_exactly_3_resume_calls asserts exactly 3 dispatched stages per member
part5_physical_request_accounting.proven_max_60_per_run: test_full_mocked_20_member_run_exactly_60_requests asserts event_ledger.physical_requests_attempted()==60 after processing all 20 members, and a subsequent call returns ALL_MEMBERS_COMPLETE with the counter unchanged
part5_physical_request_accounting.proven_pre_dispatch_exception_excluded: test_failure_before_dispatch_does_not_consume_budget asserts physical_requests_attempted()==0 after an exception raised before the transport call
part5_physical_request_accounting.proven_post_dispatch_exception_included: test_failure_after_dispatch_consumes_budget_and_is_durably_recorded asserts physical_requests_attempted()==1 after a TimeoutError raised by the (already-dispatched) fake transport
part5_physical_request_accounting.budget_exhaustion_guard: DurableB2ZClient.dispatch() raises B2Z_P1_GLOBAL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED before any reservation is written if physical_requests_attempted() >= max_total_requests -- proven by test_global_budget_exhaustion_stops_before_the_61st_request

part6_dependency_aware_resume.strict_order_enforced: _stage_for_next() iterates STAGES_IN_ORDER and returns the first stage NOT in succeeded_stage_keys() -- MIGRATION_TX is always attempted before CREATOR_HISTORY, which is always attempted before FUNDING_TX, for a given member
part6_dependency_aware_resume.worked_example_proven: test_resume_from_interruption_after_member_4_stage_2 drives exactly 11 resume_next() calls (members 1-3 fully complete = 9, member 4 stage 1+2 = 2), simulates interruption by simply stopping, then asserts the NEXT fresh resume_next() call resolves to member 4 / FUNDING_TX -- not member 1, not member 5
part6_dependency_aware_resume.never_redispatches_completed_stage: proven structurally: _stage_for_next() only ever returns a stage whose (ordinal, stage) key is absent from succeeded_stage_keys(); DurableB2ZClient.dispatch() additionally raises B2Z_P1_DUPLICATE_STAGE_ATTEMPT as an independent second guard if a reservation already exists for that key (test_duplicate_stage_attempt_rejected)
part6_dependency_aware_resume.never_skips_incomplete_dependency: proven by test_stage_2_requires_stage_1_output_present and the blocking-member guard (test_blocked_member_raises_and_does_not_skip_ahead) -- if member N has ANY failed/not-yet-succeeded stage that was already attempted, resume_next() raises B2Z_P1_MEMBER_BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_STAGE rather than silently continuing to member N+1's stage 1
part6_dependency_aware_resume.never_resets_budget: physical_requests_attempted() is derived fresh from the durable event ledger on every call -- there is no in-memory counter that could be reset by a new process invocation

part7_durable_stage_outputs.storage: B2ZStageOutputLedger -- a single compact JSON file (NOT one file per stage, NOT full provider response bodies) keyed by sample_ordinal then stage
part7_durable_stage_outputs.explicit_exclusion: full getTransaction/getSignaturesForAddress response bodies (accountKeys arrays, full instruction lists, all 1000 signature rows) are NEVER persisted -- only the small set of scalar/short-string fields the NEXT stage's request params actually require
part7_durable_stage_outputs.estimated_size: ~1.5KB per member across all 3 stages worth of durable output (measured via a representative sample), x20 members = ~31KB total for the whole cohort -- negligible
part7_durable_stage_outputs.duplicate_write_guard: record_stage_output() raises B2Z_P1_STAGE_OUTPUT_ALREADY_RECORDED if the same (ordinal, stage) key is written twice -- an independent third guard against accidental re-processing

part8_final_member_result.no_operation_membership_created: confirmed by grep -- zero Watchtower/three_sw2/canonical_operation references anywhere in b2z_durable_execution.py (test_no_watchtower_or_operation_coupling)
part8_final_member_result.only_emitted_after_all_3_stages_pass: proven structurally -- the MEMBER_COMPLETE status is only returned from the STAGE_FUNDING_TX branch, which itself requires stage_output_ledger.get_stage_output(..., STAGE_CREATOR_HISTORY) to be non-null (raises B2Z_P1_MISSING_STAGE_2_OUTPUT otherwise), which in turn required STAGE_MIGRATION_TX's output to exist

part9_no_candidate_semantics.behavior: when stage 2 (CREATOR_HISTORY) finds zero signatures with blockTime < migration_time, resume_next() returns status='NO_CANDIDATE' immediately -- no stage-3 dispatch is attempted for that member. A subsequent resume_next() call for the same member short-circuits at the FUNDING_TX branch (stage2['no_candidate'] is true) and returns status='NO_EVIDENCE_NO_CANDIDATE' WITHOUT making any provider call.
part9_no_candidate_semantics.physical_budget_impact: exactly 2 requests consumed for a no-candidate member, not 3 -- proven by test_no_candidate_ends_member_with_only_2_requests, which also asserts no getTransaction request for any 'funding-*' target was ever sent
part9_no_candidate_semantics.contract_state_chosen: NO_EVIDENCE_NO_CANDIDATE -- a qualified terminal outcome distinct from a failure; the member's acquisition attempt is considered complete (not blocked, not retryable) with a definitive absence-of-evidence result

part10_multiple_candidate_semantics.preserved_exactly: candidates[0] after the blockTime < migration_time filter, identical to B2ZRunner's existing rule -- NO new disambiguation logic, NO additional provider calls added
part10_multiple_candidate_semantics.proof: test_multiple_candidates_selects_most_recent_before_migration constructs a fake response with 3 signatures (2 qualifying, 1 post-migration), asserts the selected candidate is the most-recent qualifying one, asserts the post-migration one was correctly excluded, and asserts exactly 1 getSignaturesForAddress call was made (event_ledger.physical_requests_attempted()==2 after stages 1+2, no extra calls)

part11_fan_out_review_flag.set_only_on_member_complete: the flag is computed as part of the FUNDING_TX stage output, so it is only ever attached to a member that has ALREADY passed the full evidence contract (proves_inbound_sol_funding, temporal check) -- it does not gate or reject anything
part11_fan_out_review_flag.does_not_change_acquisition: proven by test_review_flag_does_not_alter_request_count_or_reject_evidence -- exactly 3 requests/member (24 total for 8 members) regardless of whether the ordinal is flagged
part11_fan_out_review_flag.does_not_promote_attribution: the flag is a plain string field in the candidate-evidence output dict, never referenced by any operation/Watchtower code path (none exists in this module)
part11_fan_out_review_flag.non_flagged_members_confirmed_null: test_fan_out_review test explicitly checks ordinal 1's review_flag is None

verdict_reasoning: Both gaps identified in B2Z-P0 (no resume, no pre-dispatch durability) are now fixed in a new, fully-tested parallel module (src/acquisition/b2z_durable_execution.py) that reuses the exact same evidence-rule functions from the already-qualified b2z_execution_boundary.py without modifying it. 26 new focused tests plus the full pre-existing 60-test B2N/B2Z suite all pass. A complete 20-member/60-request mocked run was proven end-to-end, including resume from multiple injected interruption points at different stages, no-candidate short-circuiting (2 requests instead of 3), multiple-candidate selection matching the exact existing contract, fan-out review flagging for the 4 identified ordinals without altering acquisition behavior, and exhaustive failure-path accounting. A new, deterministic, B2N-independent run_id and full authorization contract are bound to the REAL committed frozen manifest and projection artifacts (not synthetic test data). Zero provider calls were made. Zero production database access. Zero Watchtower/operation coupling. RA4/V2/storage state is completely unaffected. This preflight reaches the durable-execution authorization review gate; live execution is NOT authorized by this artifact and was not performed.
